title: Reduce fungal disease pressure
category: Food growing · Pest and disease control
summary: Use spacing, airflow, clean watering and sanitation before relying on sprays.
steps: Space and prune only as appropriate for the crop to improve airflow.
Water soil rather than leaves and prefer timing that allows surfaces to dry.
Remove infected fallen material and do not move it through clean beds or compost unless safe processing is certain.
Disinfect tools between suspect plants and avoid working through wet foliage.
Seek identification when symptoms spread; different pathogens require different responses.
